one_liner: Firecrawl offers a REST API (v2) for search, scrape, crawl and map. It supports a free-tier API key, OAuth for apps, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer API keys (fc-...) are generated in the dashboard. "OAuth for apps" is an OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE, issuing fco_ access tokens and fcr_ refresh tokens. It uses public clients with dynamic registration. Some endpoints also work keyless.
access_notes: The free plan gives 1,000 credits per month with no card. A few endpoints (scrape, search, parse) also work keyless, with per-IP limits.
blocker_notes: No blocker. The free tier and self-serve OAuth are available. Free credits are limited, so heavy use needs a paid plan.

evidence.quote: An app where each user connects their own Firecrawl account | OAuth for apps | `https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/...` | `Authorization: Bearer fco_...` access token.
Firecrawl runs an OAuth 2.1 authorization server. Your app sends the user to Firecrawl, the user signs in and picks a team
Requests need an `Authorization` header with your API key, except on the keyless endpoints described below
New accounts start on the free plan. It costs nothing and does not need a card.
Sign up for a free API key to get 1,000 credits and higher rate limits at no cost
All requests use the following base URL: https://api.firecrawl.dev
Official MCP server - Search, scrape, and interact with the web from Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients
API-key connections use `https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp` with a bearer token instead
